label: Illustrative AI output
callWith: Daughter Karen Lindqvist-Haug, under the HIPAA authorisation on file

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Hi, is this Karen? This is Maria, the nurse case manager with Prairie Health. You're listed with an authorisation for your mother, Dorothy.

transcript.speaker: Daughter
transcript.text: Yes, that's me. I called on Saturday about home health and the meals.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: I saw that. First, I want to check her blood thinner. Which one is she taking?

transcript.speaker: Daughter
transcript.text: The SNF said apixaban, the new expensive one. But the old warfarin bottle is still on the kitchen counter.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Could she have taken any warfarin since she came home?

transcript.speaker: Daughter
transcript.text: I don't think so? She might have taken one on Saturday, out of habit. I'm not sure. I'll ask her.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Any bruising, nosebleeds, or blood in the urine or stool?

transcript.speaker: Daughter
transcript.text: Not that she's told me. A bruise on her arm from the SNF, that's all.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: How is she managing at home?

transcript.speaker: Daughter
transcript.text: She can't stand long enough to cook, and Dad can't be left alone. A neighbour has been bringing food.

transcript.speaker: Daughter
transcript.text: She's still using the loaner from the SNF. The new one hasn't come.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Has she fallen since coming home?

transcript.speaker: Daughter
transcript.text: No falls. She can't get to the landline in the kitchen in time, though, so call me first.
